description_snippet:
Role: Program Manager - Digital Lending

Location: Bangalore (5 days, work from office)

Experience: 4-6 years

About the Role:

We are looking for a high-ownership Program Manager - Digital Lending to drive strategic and execution-focused programs across its digital lending business.

The role will own and coordinate initiatives across the end-to-end digital lending lifecycle - customer acquisition/application, credit assessment, lender allocation, approval, offer generation, documentation, and disbursal.

You will work closely with lending partners, credit/risk, product, engineering, business, operations, and customer experience teams to identify bottlenecks, improve lending funnel metrics, launch new initiatives, and build scalable lending processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring a combination of program management, lending domain knowledge, analytical problem-solving, and strong execution capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own and drive key digital lending programs and initiatives from planning through execution and measurable business outcomes.

- Manage the end-to-end lending funnel, from customer application and credit evaluation through lender approval and final disbursal.

- Identify bottlenecks across the lending journey and drive initiatives to improve approval rates, conversion rates, disbursal rates, and turnaround time (TAT).

- Work closely with lending partners to improve credit decisioning, lender allocation, approval rates, operational processes, and disbursal efficiency.

- Coordinate with product and engineering teams to implement lending workflows, lender integrations, process improvements, and automation initiatives.

- Work with credit/risk teams to understand rejection patterns, approval criteria, policy changes, and opportunities to improve portfolio and funnel performance.

- Track critical lending metrics and build structured reporting around applications, approvals, rejections, conversions, disbursals, lender perf

description_snippet:
Location: Mumbai

Experience: 3 - 7 Years

Industry: Banking / Financial Services / FinTech

Role Overview:

We are looking for a highly analytical and process-oriented Product Manager to own and manage the Business Rule Engine (BRE) ecosystem (e.g., FICO, Sentinel) for lending products. You will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and automating credit underwriting policies for a high-traffic app marketplace.

Key Responsibilities:

1) BRE Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle of the Business Rule Engine to drive automated decisioning.

2) Policy Management: Collaborate with Risk, Analytics, and Data Science teams to define and configure underwriting policies and credit scorecards.

3) Optimization: Monitor daily performance of decisioning logic and optimize rules to improve conversion rates while adhering to risk appetite.

4) Segment Curation: Work closely with AI Product Managers to curate policies for specific user segments on a regular basis.

5) Compliance & Audit: Ensure all policies comply with RBI, security, and privacy regulations; serve as the point of contact for internal/external credit audits.

6) Technical Implementation: Translate business requirements into functional specs (BRD/FRD) and work with tech teams on BRE staging and API integrations.

7) Data Analysis: Use data to identify trends and gaps in underwriting models to implement enhancements.

Required Qualifications:

1) Experience: 3-7 years in risk or product management within FinTech/Banking, focusing on credit risk or Lending Management Systems (LMS).

2) BRE Expertise (Must Have): Hands-on experience with Business Rule Engines such as FICO, Sentinel, Experian, or similar underwriting engines.

3) Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of APIs, data flow, and SQL for data validation is mandatory.

4) Risk Knowledge: Deep understanding of Indian retail lending regulations (RBI), KYC/AML guidelines, and credit risk assessment techniques.

5) Education: MBA in Finance/Syst

description_snippet:
Job Requirements 
Role/Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Structured Trade Finance

Function/ Department: Wholesale Banking

Job Purpose:

The purpose is to focus on the growth and evolution of our structured trade finance franchise, with aim of expanding market share, designing client-led solutions that enable corporates and financial institutions to manage complex trade flows. The position will act as a subject matter expert, collaborate with cross-functional teams, Off-shore Banking Units (GIFT City IBU) of the Bank and engage with Financial Institutions/ Banks/ Corporate clients to deliver best-in-class structured trade finance solutions.  

Roles & Responsibilities:

Define and execute product strategy for structured trade finance, covering payable finance, receivable finance, inventory finance, export finance, risk participation, financing from Gift city IBU etc. Identify market trends, client needs, and regulatory changes to design innovative structured trade solutions.Identify opportunities across sectors and develop sector-specific financing models. Partner with coverage, risk, compliance, legal, other product teams and sales teams to customized structured trade solutions that balance client requirements with prudent risk management.Monitor competitive dynamics and industry benchmarks to refine strategy. Maintain strong market engagement with corporates, industry bodies, and regulators.Own the product P&L including pricing, risk-return optimization, and revenue targets.Tie-ups with various new age tech platforms providing value added solutions in the area of trade finance. Project management for new initiatives, to drive overall projects for timely implementation.Maintain strong engagement with FI/ Banks and Intermediaries.Educational Qualifications: 

Graduation: Any graduate

Post Graduation: Any post graduate

Experience: 10-18 years of relevant experience in managing structured trade product.
